metadata.description: Agent Runbooks gallery: runbooks to install and adapt

plugins.name: runbook-review-loop
plugins.description: A review loop around one code change: a coder implements the brief, a reviewer reads the changes and runs the checks, the coder fixes the findings until none are left, and the human decides when the fix rounds run out. Every step is a subagent of the session itself; nothing else to install.

plugins.name: runbook-implement-task
plugins.description: One coding task end to end: a coder, the project's checks, two independent reviews by different models, triage, fix rounds with verification, a polish pass. Runs its subagents through throng-mcp; a project adapts it with one profile file.
